name: Elune's Grace
summary: In Darnassus, young night elf priests answer a call from the Sisterhood of Elune. Their early journeys prepare them for deeper instruction from Priestess Alathea.

sections.title: A Sacred Calling
sections.body: The Sisterhood of Elune guides young acolytes in the Temple of the Moon, from their first prayers toward mastery of lunar magic. Night elves place their faith in the Mother Moon, Elune, unlike humans and dwarves, whose priests follow the Holy Light. When a novice priest reaches a milestone in devotion, senior mentors take notice and mark the disciple as ready to bear greater divine power.

sections.title: Blessings of the Moon Goddess
sections.body: Priestess Alathea brings the Sisterhood's summons to the acolyte. She recognizes their dedication and welcomes them into traditions preserved across millennia. By accepting the rite, the priest seals a bond to Elune and gains access to protective wards and lunar invocations unique to the kaldorei faith.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The rite marks a spiritual milestone for night elf priests. It calls an acolyte back to Darnassus, where Priestess Alathea recognizes their growth and grants them higher teachings from the Sisterhood of Elune.
Priestess Alathea is a respected trainer of the Sisterhood of Elune in Darnassus. She guides developing kaldorei priests as they deepen their communion with the Moon Goddess.

faq.q: Why is this gift specific to night elves?
faq.answer: Night elf priests venerate Elune directly, while human and dwarven priests draw upon the Holy Light. The Sisterhood's invocations, including Elune's Grace, reflect lunar protection and defensive enchantments cultivated by the kaldorei over thousands of years.

faq.q: Where does this ceremony take place?
faq.answer: The summons is answered in Darnassus, at the Temple of the Moon, where the city's priesthood gathers and teaches.

faq.q: Do other Alliance priests receive a similar calling?
faq.answer: Each culture approaches the priesthood differently. Humans and dwarves study the tenets of the Holy Light under their own mentors in Stormwind and Ironforge, gaining racial disciplines distinct from the moon magic practiced by night elves.

faq.q: What state of devotion is Alathea referring to?
faq.answer: Alathea means the spiritual fortitude and maturity gained through trials in the wider world. Survival, discipline, and steadfast adherence to Elune's virtues show that an acolyte can channel stronger lunar blessings safely.

angles.text: As a priest, you follow a kaldorei faith distinct from the Light-based doctrines of humans and dwarves, with your craft rooted in Elune's protection.
As a night elf, you inherit Elune's Grace through ancient traditions preserved by the Sisterhood of Elune.
